caption: The drawing depicts a wooden roll-top desk with a reddish-brown hue and elaborate detailing. The desk features three main sections: the base with three columns of drawers, each column containing three drawers fitted with ornate, gold-colored handles; ornamental legs with floral and scrollwork designs supporting the desk; and a slanted writing surface that is open and supported on both sides. Above the writing surface, the interior compartments are visible, consisting of multiple small drawers, arched pigeonholes, and one central arched door, all in the same reddish wood. The detailed illustration uses shading and fine lines to render depth and texture, and the background is plain with no other objects present.
title: Desk
